name: Laras pelog degung (satu set terdokumentasi)
description: Pentatonis dengan langkah lebar dan sempit yang berselang — inilah warna degung Sunda. Seperti salendro, pelog degung berbeda antar perangkat; angka ini satu set terdokumentasi dan boleh Anda ubah.
descriptionEn: Pentatonic with alternating wide and narrow steps — the Sundanese degung colour. Like salendro, pelog degung varies between sets; these cents are one documented interval set, editable.

source.title: Jaap Kunst, Music in Java (Martinus Nijhoff, 1949), pelog interval measurements; Sundanese degung as the five-tone subset da–mi–na–ti–la
source.note: Rounded to the nearest 5 cents from the cited measurements. Individual gamelan degung and angklung sets differ audibly from these values, which is the point of shipping them as editable data.
